thread:
Aisha (People Ops): Quick post-all-hands checklist thread for hybrid/offsite ops  ask short Qs about last-minute travel, rooming, accessibility, and any policies we didn't cover live. Will update handbook after.

Noor (Eng): If someone needs to cancel last-minute (48h), how do refunds get handled?

Aisha (People Ops): Cancellation within 72h: fees may apply. We absorb fees only for medical/approved emergencies with receipts. Add cancellation contingency in the Offsite Request. Link: https://intranet.redwood/offsites

Elena (Recruiting): Candidate interview travel: can we book rideshares instead of reimbursing mileage? Any rules?

Devon (Finance): Yes, rideshares OK. Keep receipts. For high-volume candidate travel, Recruiting can set up a central account or request expense pre-approval.

Theo (SRE): For team sprints, can we reserve a dedicated room for the whole week and leave equipment overnight?

Aisha (People Ops): You can reserve Team Suites for multi-day sprints via the booking portal. Overnight equipment storage depends on the hubs security policy coordinate with Facilities. Add "secure storage" in your request.

Noor (Eng): Any guidance on carpooling/shuttle options for offsites? We prefer shared transport.

Aisha (People Ops): Great ideainclude a "transport plan" in the Offsite Request. We can book shuttles or recommend vendor carpooling and include cost in the budget. If using personal vehicles, mileage rules apply.

Elena (Recruiting): Dietary/allergy accommodations for vendors and candidates  who needs to sign off?

Aisha (People Ops): Mark dietary restrictions on the attendee list in the Offsite Request. People Ops will coordinate with caterer. Allergies flagged as critical get special labeling on meals.

Security-Bot: Reminder: after-hours access must be registered in Access Portal. Unregistered long stays may trigger security outreach.

Theo (SRE): Is there a green travel incentive? A few on my team want to offset carbon for flights.

Aisha (People Ops): We have a small Green Travel stipend for team-led offsets on approved offsites. Add "carbon offset" line to the Offsite Request budget and we'll review.

Devon (Finance): Quick finance note: advance payments up to 50% available for confirmed offsite budgets; request at least 10 business days before event.

HR-Bot: Handbook update scheduled: Offsite & Workstyle edits will publish end of week. Search "offsite checklist".

Noor (Eng): One last: emergency contact / onsite medic for large offsites?

Aisha (People Ops): For events >50 people we require a local emergency contact and either onsite medic or rapid-response plan. Add emergency contact in the Offsite Request and People Ops will coordinate with Facilities.

Aisha (People Ops): Thanks all  pinning the Offsite Request, budget template, consent blurb, and a short checklist in #people-ops. DM for visa letters or special approvals and I'll set a quick 15-min slot. :thumbsup:
